uncited: - **Depth Buffer:** A 2D array storing the minimum depth value for each pixel $(u, v)$ across all surface points projected to that pixel.
**Visibility Check:** For each voxel corner, determine if it is "visible" to any camera.
- **Holes in Mesh:** The method fails on non-watertight meshes.
If a mesh has holes, a camera may see "inside" the mesh through the hole, causing the depth buffer to record a deeper surface point.
- **Time Complexity:** Proportional to the number of voxel corners multiplied by the number of cameras.
Projection and depth lookup are $O(1)$ per corner per camera.
- **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing depth buffers for all cameras.
Size depends on image resolution and number of cameras.
- **When to use:** When the mesh is watertight and normal-based methods produce artifacts.
